steps.operation: Resolve each crease with an Eguchi-Hanson patch.

formula.plain_text: The singular set of T^7/Gamma is 12 disjoint three-tori, one Gamma-orbit of 4 fixed tori each, from 3 singular involutions. Every one is an A_1 locus and a flat T^3 with Betti numbers (1, 3, 3, 1), so b_1 = 3 on each. The resolution adds one 2-class per component (b_2 = 12) and three 3-classes per component (b_3 = 7 + 3 x 12).

formula.plain_text: M-theory on the resolved Y_7 gives b_2 = 12 U(1) vector multiplets and b_3 neutral chiral multiplets. At the orbifold point each of the 12 singular loci is C^2/Z_2 x T^3 with trivial monodromy, carrying SU(2) with 1 + b_1(T^3) = 4 fermion zero modes: the content of pure N = 4 super Yang-Mills, which neither confines nor forms a gaugino condensate. A gaugino-condensation racetrack has no gauge sector to come from on this geometry; pure N = 1 would need b_1 = 0, the reflected case that A_1 admissibility excludes.

formula.plain_text: Each of the 3 singular involutions acts as -1 on its transverse T^4 with 16 fixed points (counted); resolving them gives a Kummer K3 with chi = 24, both from the quotient and from its Betti numbers. Read as 2 x sum chi(K3) over the two shadows, chi_eff = 144 (72 per shadow), so chi_eff/48 = 3: the same statement as counting singular involutions, and it holds on every class of the family, where b_2/4 does not. This reading is chi_eff's definition since 2026-10-01 (D-015, chi_eff_route = k3_reading); it is an index of the K3 surfaces, not the Euler characteristic of Y_7, which is 0.
formula.label: (CG.9)
